objects.taxonomy_description: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face 20-40 cm in diameter. Face features hour numerals (Arabic, Roman, or markers) arranged in a 12-hour circle. Two or three hands (hour, minute, second) rotate from the center. Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes (oak, black, white, brass). Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back. Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery. Glass or plastic crystal covers the face. Some models have a pendulum visible below the face. Overall depth is 5-10 cm.

objects.taxonomy_description: Large penguin measuring 85-95 cm in height with distinctive black and white plumage. Head, back, and flippers are glossy black with vibrant orange-yellow auricular patches extending from ear region down neck sides. Breast and belly are white transitioning to pale yellow on upper breast. Bill is long, slender, and black with bright orange-pink lower mandible and base. Flippers are stiff and paddle-shaped, black on both surfaces. Feet are black and webbed. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with upright torpedo-shaped profile adapted for swimming. Neck is elongated with orange coloration. Juveniles display brown-grey plumage lacking orange markings. Weight ranges 9-18 kg. Flightless; swims using flipper propulsion.

objects.taxonomy_description: A suitcase is a rigid or semi-rigid rectangular container with a handle, designed for carrying personal belongings during travel.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct rectangular or box-like geometry with defined edges and corners.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Carrying_Mechanism: A prominent handle is attached to the top or side, often accompanied by wheels at the base.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Components: Visible hinges, latches, or a zipper line indicate a two-part clamshell or opening design.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior surface is typically smooth, hard-shell plastic, metal, or woven fabric, lacking organic textures.
